categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Jingyuan Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the industrial water treatment sector, focusing on industrial wastewater and water supply treatment. Its business segments include equipment and system integration (EP), engineering procurement and construction (EPC), design and consulting services (E), and infrastructure investment, construction, and operation. The company serves industries such as power generation, steel, chemical, municipal, and metal products, providing comprehensive environmental protection solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary core technologies including industrial wastewater electronic coagulation treatment, intelligent superconducting magnetic medium coagulation sedimentation, high-difficulty wastewater zero discharge, and high-difficulty wastewater electrocatalytic oxidation. It employs customized design and manufacturing methods, integrating core components produced in-house with standard equipment procured externally. Production follows a make-to-order model with intelligent system integration and digital management platforms like MES and WMS to enhance efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large industrial enterprises primarily in the power generation sector, including major state-owned power groups, as well as steel, chemical, municipal, and metal product industries. The company has established long-term relationships with leading power companies such as Huaneng Group, Datang Group, Huadian Group, and others. It also serves non-power sectors like Yulin Chemical and Handan Steel, expanding its market reach domestically and internationally along the Belt and Road countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with business concentrated in North China, East China, South China, Northwest, Northeast, Central China, and Southwest regions. It has established marketing and operational branches in Guangzhou, Beijing, and Xi'an, covering nationwide markets. Additionally, it actively expands overseas markets through its wholly-owned subsidiary Guangdong Jingyuan, targeting Belt and Road countries for international cooperation and project execution.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Jingyuan Environmental Protection operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial water treatment supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and integrates water treatment equipment and systems, provides engineering construction services, and offers operation and maintenance services. The company procures standard equipment and materials externally while producing core components internally, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in the environmental protection industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on advancing core technologies and intelligent digital transformation. It invests significantly in R&D, collaborating with top academic and research institutions to develop cutting-edge water treatment technologies. Strategic R&D projects include superconducting magnetic coagulation equipment, chemical wastewater zero discharge, AI-based intelligent dosing systems, and emerging pollutant removal technologies. The company aims to enhance product efficiency, reduce costs, and expand into new markets such as municipal water treatment and drinking water purification.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of customized industrial water treatment equipment and systems, engineering contracting services, design and consulting services, and infrastructure investment and operation. The company secures projects primarily via bidding and tendering processes, with staged payments linked to project milestones including deposits, delivery acceptance, commissioning, and warranty periods. It also earns income from operation and maintenance services, and occasionally from government subsidies and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Jingyuan Environmental Protection holds a strong competitive position in the power industry water treatment market, with recognized technological advantages in electronic coagulation and magnetic medium coagulation technologies. However, the industry is fragmented with many small players, resulting in relatively low market share for the company. It is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise, with a growing presence in non-power sectors like steel and chemical industries, aiming to consolidate its leadership through technology and service differentiation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 396.16 million, a decline of 22.97% compared to the previous year, primarily due to macroeconomic headwinds and delayed project deliveries. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 29.23 million, reflecting a significant decrease from prior profitability. Total assets grew by 10.61% to RMB 1.897 billion, while shareholders' equity decreased by 5.67% to RMB 810.95 million. The company maintains substantial R&D investment, accounting for 7.8% of revenue, and continues to expand its asset base and operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary advanced water treatment technologies that offer high efficiency, low chemical usage, and reduced operational costs. Its integrated service model covers the full lifecycle from design, manufacturing, installation to operation and maintenance, providing tailored solutions to complex industrial wastewater challenges. The adoption of intelligent digital platforms enhances system monitoring and management, improving reliability and customer service. Recognized as a national high-tech and specialized enterprise, it emphasizes sustainable and green technologies aligned with China's ecological and carbon neutrality goals.
